messages:
mira: Starting thread for ArgonSys Aurora-M joint perf bench. Aim: map perf/W across microcode DVFS profiles, validate our 4-bit quant path, and produce a short ops playbook for the marketplace image. Working notes: https://go/redwood/partnerships/argon-aurora

sanjay: Nice. Outline: (1) microcode calibration single-board, (2) multi-board sweep (n=3) with defined V/F steps, (3) soak/regression. Dry-run Monday 09:00 PT.

tom: FYI thermal spikes seen at seq>=768. For stage 2 lock fan curve and capture full rail telemetry + VRM temps. Can we get instrumented boards?

argon-eng: We'll ship two instrumented Aurora-M boards and a microcode candidate (mc-dvfs-v2). Uploaded to s3://argon/aurora/fw/mc-dvfs-v2/sha256=fa5e2c7e. Also providing recommended BIOS knobs and a bench wrapper for per-rail logs.

bench-bot: automated: tag artifacts with run_id and bench_tag. Template: run_id=argon-aurora-<YYYYMMDD>-<board> bench_tag=argon-aurora-m-v2. Include firmware_sha and reservation_id in metadata.

mira: Metrics to capture: power.sample=0.5s, GPU power draw, package_temp, vrm_temp, memory_bw, latency P50/P95/P99, throughput at batch=1 and batch=8. Perf counters: L1D_PREFETCH, L2_MISSES, LLC_REFERENCES.

sanjay: We'll test three microcode V/F points plus stock. Also run two kernel builds: upstream-stock and argon-mprefetch. A/B to isolate kernel vs microcode impacts. Model pinned to redwood/llama-7b@v1.4-quant.

tom: Traffic: synthetic with 10% short-prefix hits, poisson arrival. For steady throughput runs use batch=8 offline. Canary on one board first.

infra-scheduler: reservation created: rsv-2026-10-05-argon-3boards (link). Please add rsv id to run manifest.

argon-eng: Board serials uploaded: s3://argon/aurora/boards/serials.csv. Firmware sha: sha256=fa5e2c7e. We'll be available for canary and will co-author the marketplace blurb.

mira: Action items: argon-eng upload fw + serials; tom publish perf script; sanjay draft manifest with kernel commits and microcode tags; bench-bot ensure tags; infra add reservation id. I'll draft the external-facing blurb after artifacts look clean.

tom: Perf collection snippet: ```bash
# collect sensors + perf counters
./scripts/collect_telemetry.sh --sample 0.5 --out ./artifacts/argon-telemetry.json
perf stat -e L1D_PREFETCH,L2_MISSES,LLC_REFERENCES -o ./artifacts/argon-perf.txt -- ./run_bench.sh --model llama-7b --seq 512 --iter 30
```

sanjay: Manifest published: https://go/redwood/bench/argon/manifest.md includes env matrix, microcode commits, kernel commits, fw shas, and expected output schema.

bench-bot: scheduled dry-run Mon 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants. Remember to tag artifacts.

mira: Scheduling: canary Mon 09:00 PT; full sweep Tue 22:00 PT (overnight). If canary passes we'll mark artifacts "partner-reviewed" and proceed to generate the marketplace one-pager highlighting perf/W delta and methodology.

argon-eng: Agreed. We'll standby during canary and provide on-call support. Happy to co-author the marketplace note if results are strong.

mira: Great. Post any blockers here (FW issues, thermal alarms, infra conflicts).
